info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Creditcard Applications Documents-v2-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve documents associated with credit card applications. It allows financial institutions and application reviewers to access pertinent documentation required for processing credit card applications efficiently. Key resources include the various documents linked to each application, which support decision-making and compliance purposes. Typical consumers include lenders, credit analysts, and risk assessors who need quick access to supporting application materials.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of application documents.
get.description: This endpoint allows the user to retrieve a comprehensive list of documents associated with applications. It provides essential information about each document which can be used for further processing or review.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving documents associated with applications. This endpoint expects a JSON payload that specifies the necessary parameters to filter or query the documents.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of documents.
